'''Gérald Bastard''' (born 3 April 1950 in [[Paris]]<ref name="isi">[http://hcr3.isiknowledge.com/author.cgi?id=142 Bastard, Gerald] at [[ISIHighlyCited.com]]. Accessed 2011-01-26{{dead link|date=March 2014}}</ref>) is a [[ISI highly cited researcher|highly cited]]<ref>{{cite web|title=B - Research Analytics - Thomson Reuters|url=http://highlycited.com/names/B.html|publisher=[[Institute for Scientific Information#ISI Highly Cited|ISI Highly Cited]]|access-date=28 February 2014}}</ref>  French [[physicist]] known for his work on [[semiconductor]] [[heterostructure]]s. {{Asof|2011}}, he is a research director at the Department of Physics of the [[École Normale Supérieure]] in Paris.

==Education==
Bastard completed his Ph.D. in 1974 at [[Université Paris Diderot]], titled ''Observation des effets de non-centrosymétrie et des niveaux accepteurs dans Hg Te par l'étude de la magnéto-absorption''.<ref name=phd>{{cite thesis | last=Bastard | first=Gérald  | title=Observation des effets de non-centrosymétrie et des niveaux accepteurs dans Hg Te par l'étude de la magnéto-absorption | publisher= | publication-place= | year=1974 | oclc=708311121 | language=| page=}}</ref>

==Awards==
In 2000, Bastard and [[Emilio E. Mendez]] won the International Symposium on Compound Semiconductors
Quantum Device Award "for pioneering work on electric-field induced optic effects in [[quantum well]]s and [[superlattice]]s ([[quantum-confined Stark effect]] and [[superlattice#Wannier–Stark ladder|Wannier–Stark localization]])".<ref>{{Cite journal | doi = 10.1002/pssc.201090015 | title = Awards: phys. stat. sol. (c) 7/10 | journal = [[Physica Status Solidi C]] | volume = 7 | issue = 10 | pages = 2353–2357 | year = 2010 |bibcode = 2010PSSCR...7.2353. }}</ref>
